scope: Repository source and committed artifacts; no live provider request was executed by this repair.

changes: Cursor pagination follows the documented GMGN portfolio activity response cursor and accepts activities/list/data payload variants.
Resumes from per-chain checkpoint and caps a single run at 1000 pages to prevent runaway loops.
Writes a completed archive only after pagination is judged complete; merges prior records rather than replacing them.
Malformed responses, subprocess errors, repeated cursors, and full pages without a cursor are recorded as failed_or_incomplete and do not replace the completed archive.
Persists error, returncode, stderr, and status; validates GMGN_API_KEY before requests.
Offline tests cover response variants, cursor pagination, merge preservation, malformed responses, and refusing to overwrite a completed archive when pagination completeness is unknown.
Serializes backfill archive writers and runs offline safety tests before provider calls.
Uses a 100-row default page size and preserves artifacts/status even if the backfill step fails.
Runs the new backfill tests and compiles the backfill modules on pull requests as well as main pushes.
Fixes JSON output newline escaping so successful checkpoints and final archives remain parseable JSON.

previous_audit_snapshot.note: These are the committed audit's measured values for the historical snapshot, not a fresh provider query.

not_yet_verified_or_not_yet_solved: No live GMGN backfill was run during this code repair; actual API-key validity, cursor values returned by the user's account, rate limits, and available historical depth remain unverified.
The current backfill workflow accepts one wallet per run. It does not yet enumerate the full discovered-wallet population or automatically populate the historical-discovery engine.
gmgn_layer.portfolio_activity still makes a single non-paginated runtime call; the new pagination is in the dedicated wallet backfill path, not the live signal path.
The existing GMGN smart-money archive is a forward feed and its measured span remains under 9 days; code changes cannot manufacture missing older events.
Nansen historical-balances data is not trade history and must not be mixed into trade-event reconstruction.
The 1000-page guard is a safety boundary, not proof that the provider has 1000 pages or supports a 90/180/365-day window. A run that hits it fails incomplete and retains its checkpoint.
The old gmgn_backfill_capability_audit.json is a snapshot of the pre-repair state; this file records the repair delta and remaining limitations.

safety.note: No order execution code or live-order setting was enabled or changed by this repair.
